## Biography

Gliese 506.2 is a system in independent space and a scheduled waypoint on the Independent Detention Foundation's prisoner transit route. In September 3312, the Riker-class Reformatory EVE-597 failed to arrive there after jumping from Nones, and no trace of the vessel has since been found.
